summary: This paper addresses hand-object contact transition detection in egocentric video, aiming to localize the touch and release moments of contact episodes. It proposes a unified approach for this computer vision task.

title: When Reconstruction Helps Event-Camera Person Triggers
summary: This research investigates how different reconstruction methods, such as intensity reconstructors and temporal encodings, improve the use of event camera data for general visual models acting as person recording triggers.

title: Reasoning-Aware Relational Representation Learning for Open-Vocabulary Scene Graph Generation
summary: This paper proposes a reasoning-aware relational representation learning approach for Open-Vocabulary Scene Graph Generation. The method aims to enable models to recognize visual relationships beyond their training vocabulary, improving performance under challenging conditions.

title: Dark Matters: VAE-Aware HDR Encoding for SDR-to-HDR Video Reconstruction
summary: This research introduces VAE-Aware HDR Encoding for SDR-to-HDR video reconstruction, addressing the challenge of recovering clipped highlights and crushed shadows. It leverages latent diffusion models as generative priors to restore missing detail while preserving original content.

title: Distribution Shift Detection in Remote Sensing Imagery using Machine Learning Models
summary: This research investigates distribution shift detection in remote sensing imagery captured by Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). It addresses challenges when deploying machine learning models on resource-constrained aerial platforms where deployment data may differ from training data.

title: Evidential Deep Learning with conditional entropy for glaucoma detection
summary: This paper proposes a novel conditional entropy function for quantifying predictive uncertainty in Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) for glaucoma detection. The method is applied to retinal fundus images for improved diagnostic reliability.

title: Seeing the Small: Deformable Duality Mamba for Retinal Lesion Segmentation
summary: This paper introduces Deformable Duality Mamba, a method for retinal lesion segmentation, specifically for diabetic retinopathy. It aims to improve the segmentation of small and irregular lesions by modeling spatial organization and using shape-adaptive scanning.

title: UniWeaver: Harnessing Unified Multimodal Models for Interleaved Text-Image Generation
summary: This paper introduces UniWeaver, a new system that harnesses unified multimodal models for interleaved text-image generation. It aims to improve the coordination between text and image modalities to create coherent multimodal compositions from user requests.

title: AgenticConflictLens: From Long Traffic Videos to Verifiable Conflict Evidence
summary: This paper introduces AgenticConflictLens, a system designed to extract verifiable conflict evidence from long traffic videos. It functions as an agentic system to identify safety-critical events, such as near misses and unsafe maneuvers, from continuous road-user behavior footage.

title: PhyRubric: Rubric-Grounded Diagnostic Evaluation of Physical Commonsense in Text-to-Video Generation
summary: This paper introduces PhyRubric, a rubric-grounded diagnostic evaluation method for assessing physical commonsense in text-to-video generation models. It aims to provide a more objective evaluation than existing benchmarks, which often rely on subjective annotator intuition.

title: Lightweight Deep Learning Framework for Astrocyte-Centric 3D Reconstruction across Normal and Stress-associated Ultrastructural States
summary: This research proposes a lightweight deep learning framework for astrocyte-centric 3D reconstruction from volume electron microscopy data. The framework aims to simplify the reconstruction of astrocyte morphology across various ultrastructural states, addressing current labor and computational intensity.

title: When to Start Denoising? Adaptive Denoising Entry for Generative Video Compression
summary: This paper proposes an adaptive denoising entry strategy to improve generative video compression, leveraging diffusion-based models for better performance under low bitrate constraints.

title: FlashMotion: Ultra-Fast Long-Term 3D Motion Generation
summary: FlashMotion is introduced as a method for ultra-fast, long-term 3D human motion generation, crucial for applications in game development, XR, and embodied simulation.

title: picoEmergencyNet : Attention-Enhanced Ultra-Small Deep Learning Model for Aerial Image Classification in Emergency Monitoring
summary: picoEmergencyNet is an attention-enhanced, ultra-small deep learning model designed for efficient aerial image classification in emergency monitoring on resource-constrained UAV platforms.

title: Predicting Single-Cell Spatial Gene Expression from H&E using Pathology Foundation Models
summary: This research explores using pathology foundation models to predict single-cell spatial gene expression directly from H&E images, offering a scalable method for molecular insights from histology.

title: EgoHMP: Achieving Precise Human Motion Prediction in 3D Scenes via Egocentric Cues
summary: EgoHMP proposes a new method to achieve precise human motion prediction in 3D scenes by incorporating egocentric cues, addressing challenges with traditional gaze-based approaches.

title: Exploring Synchrony for Communication in Modular Neural Networks
summary: This study investigates the role of synchrony in facilitating communication within modular neural networks, aiming to improve compositional generalization.

title: Maze Runner: Autonomous Maze Navigation with Line-Based Localization and Control Barrier Functions
summary: Maze Runner is an open autonomy stack for autonomous maze navigation, utilizing line-based localization and control barrier functions for planning and safe control.

title: CAFE: Closed-Loop Autonomous Task Formulation and Execution without Instance-Specific Instructions
summary: CAFE presents a closed-loop system for autonomous task formulation and execution in robots, allowing them to select and perform tasks based on scene observations without explicit instructions.

title: RoboACE: Adversarial Co-Evolution for Robot Self-Improvement
summary: RoboACE proposes adversarial co-evolution to enable robot agents to self-improve their skills, planning procedures, and recovery strategies through continuous practice and feedback.

title: Robo-MLT: Dual-System Robotic Manipulation for Long-Horizon Medical Laboratory Tasks
summary: Robo-MLT introduces a dual-system robotic manipulation framework for automating long-horizon medical laboratory tasks, ensuring reliable workflow execution and adaptability to changes.

title: ASPIRE: An Agentic System-Identification Platform for Iterative Reasoning and Exploration
summary: ASPIRE is an agentic platform that uses a large language model agent to select and execute system identification methods, incorporating prior physical knowledge for iterative reasoning and exploration.

title: How Much of Your VLA Is kNN
summary: This work analyzes the performance of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, investigating how much of their success on benchmarks is attributable to k-nearest neighbor retrieval of demonstrations.

title: Ground Reaction Force-Aware Model Predictive Control for Underactuated Upright Physical Assistance
summary: This paper presents Ground Reaction Force-Aware Model Predictive Control (GRF-MPC), a framework for upright physical assistance robots that explicitly incorporates human-ground interaction for improved control.

title: Latent Barrier Steering: Hierarchical Safety for Generative Planning
summary: Latent Barrier Steering (LBS) is a hierarchical framework introduced to ensure safety in generative planning, particularly for flow-matching-based methods, through semantic-to-path control.

title: Incorporating World Models in Decision Making for Next Best View Selection in Active Sensing
summary: This research explores incorporating world models into robotic decision-making for optimal next-best-view selection, enhancing efficient 3D reconstruction in active sensing applications.

title: Curie's Jarvis: Autonomous Robotic Chemistry Experiments from Printed Protocols
summary: Curie's Jarvis demonstrates an autonomous robotic system capable of conducting chemistry experiments directly from printed protocols, streamlining laboratory automation.

title: Large Language Model Explainability for Planning Lunar Rover Trajectories under Uncertainty
summary: This study explores using large language model explainability to assist in planning lunar rover trajectories, addressing the challenges of multi-objective optimization under uncertainty.

title: PneuGen: Task-Driven Agentic Co-Design of Soft Pneumatic Robots
summary: PneuGen presents a task-driven agentic co-design approach for soft pneumatic robots, using computational optimization to explore complex design spaces for geometry, morphology, and materials.

title: AHEADance: Anticipatory Humanoid Dance from Streaming Audio
summary: AHEADance introduces a robot-native streaming dance generator that enables a humanoid robot to perform anticipatory dance movements to live-streamed audio using a whole-body tracker.

title: Discrete Model-Based Diffusion for Combinatorial Optimization in Multi-Robot Task Allocation
summary: This paper proposes using discrete model-based diffusion for combinatorial optimization in multi-robot task allocation, addressing NP-hard problems in real-time.

title: Rhythmic-Semantic Co-Speech Gestures for Emotional Dialogue in Robots
summary: This research presents an emotion-aware rhythmic-semantic co-speech gesture system that enables robots to generate more natural and engaging gestures during emotional dialogue.

title: ExRL: Sample-Efficient Online Adaptation of Long-Chunk Policies via Execution Length Control
summary: This paper introduces ExRL, a method for sample-efficient online adaptation of long-chunk robot policies, addressing the high sample requirements of existing reinforcement learning methods.

title: Route-Time Conflict Maps for Cooperative End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: This research proposes using Route-Time Conflict Maps to improve cooperative end-to-end autonomous driving, allowing vehicles to share intentions beyond mere status, preventing deadlocks.

title: DeRep: Learning Depth Representations for End-to-End Navigation in Cluttered Environments
summary: This paper introduces DeRep, a method for learning depth representations to enhance end-to-end navigation for mobile robots in cluttered environments, supporting collision avoidance and goal-directed motion.

title: Differentiable Filtering for Inertial Odometry
summary: This paper introduces Differentiable Filtering to improve inertial odometry accuracy, which is critical for autonomous systems, by addressing unbounded drift from sensor noise and biases.

title: GEMOR-GS: Global Extrinsic-calibration-refined Mapping and Online Relocalization for 3D Gaussian-Splatting SLAM
summary: This paper presents GEMOR-GS, a 3D Gaussian-Splatting SLAM system for robots that provides photorealistic and metrically consistent world representations for continuous operation, including mapping and online relocalization.

title: Few-Shot Residual Adaptation of Pretrained Latent World Models
summary: This research investigates few-shot residual adaptation for pretrained latent world models, enabling them to adapt to changing physical dynamics during deployment with minimal interaction and without modifying pretrained weights.

title: Ego Guidance: Enhancing Robot Policy Learning with Action-Free Human Egocentric Videos
summary: This paper proposes "Ego Guidance," a method enhancing robot policy learning by leveraging action-free human egocentric videos and a pretrained VLM for future visual state prediction.

title: Joint-State Inference for Autonomous Excavators Using Cab-View Vision-Control Fusion
summary: This paper proposes a closed-loop autonomous excavation system using cab-view vision-control fusion for reliable joint-state inference in autonomous excavators, reducing the need for additional sensors.

title: CIALLO: Learning Shared Intent Representations for Cross-Embodiment Manipulation
summary: This research introduces CIALLO, a method for learning shared intent representations to enable effective knowledge transfer for manipulation tasks across different robot embodiments.

title: FAME-QP: A GPU-Accelerated Quadratic-Programming Solver for Real-Time Model Predictive Control
summary: This paper presents FAME-QP, a GPU-accelerated solver for dense quadratic programs used in real-time linear model predictive control, utilizing CUDA graphs for efficient execution.

title: From Depth to Safe Depth: Uncertainty-Aware Monocular Perception for Mobile Robot Navigation
summary: This research explores "Safe Depth," an uncertainty-aware monocular perception method for mobile robot navigation, addressing the safety issues of using off-the-shelf depth foundation models.

title: RiSE-Drive: Risk-Sensitive Long-Horizon Candidate Evaluation for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: This paper introduces RiSE-Drive, a method for risk-sensitive, long-horizon candidate evaluation in end-to-end autonomous driving systems, addressing trajectory selection under uncertainty.

title: Camera equalisation of an 11.5x drop in environmental illuminance: four imitation-learning policies on an SO-101 arm
summary: This research investigates the impact of environmental illuminance changes on four imitation-learning policies (ACT, SmolVLA, Diffusion Policy, pi0.5) applied to an SO-101 robot arm.

title: WAM is capable in BEHAVIOR-1K: the 2nd-place solution to the 2026 BEHAVIOR Challenge
summary: This paper presents the 2nd-place solution to the 2026 BEHAVIOR Challenge, showcasing a World Action Model (WAM) named Cosmos 3, improved with richer visual history for mobile manipulation across 100 household tasks.

title: Game-Enhanced Embodied Learning with Event and Foresight Pretraining
summary: This research introduces game-enhanced embodied learning using event and foresight pretraining for robot policies, leveraging human gameplay observations and actions to supplement training.

title: Learn-To-Propagate: Distributionally Robust Motion Planning for Nonlinear Uncertain Systems
summary: This paper introduces "Learn-To-Propagate," a method for distributionally robust motion planning in nonlinear uncertain systems, enabling safe navigation for stochastic systems.

title: ReACT: Reflection-Consistent Modulation and Cross-Load Consistency for Humanoid Velocity Tracking Under Asymmetric Loads
summary: This paper proposes ReACT, a method for reflection-consistent modulation and cross-load consistency, enabling humanoid robots to accurately track velocity commands under asymmetric loads during loco-manipulation.

title: Optimization-Based Path Planning for Industrial Manipulators: Experimental Validation in Additive Manufacturing
summary: This research develops an offline optimization-based path planner for industrial manipulators in robotic additive manufacturing, combining joint-path regularity and self-collision penalties with process constraints.

title: LaST0.5: A Generalist World Action Model with Interaction-Centric Latent Reasoning
summary: LaST0.5 is a new World Action Model (WAM) designed for robotic manipulation. It focuses on interaction-centric latent reasoning and modeling temporal and physical dynamics.

title: RedirectMimic: Local Motion Content Redaction for Humanoid Whole-Body Control
summary: RedirectMimic is a method for local motion content redaction in humanoid whole-body control. It allows controllers to replace specific movements while retaining useful reference behavior.

title: A human-in-the-loop Control Paradigm for Construction Robotics: From VR-Guided Teleoperation to Semi-Autonomous Dual-Arm Operation
summary: This paper presents a human-in-the-loop control paradigm for construction robotics. It enables structured transitions from VR-guided teleoperation to semi-autonomous dual-arm operation.

title: DexSeed: Expanding Human Hand-Object Interactions into Robot Demonstrations for Dexterous Policy Learning
summary: DexSeed studies generating diverse robot demonstrations from human hand-object interactions for dexterous vision-language-action (VLA) learning. It aims to provide reusable data for robot policy learning.

title: Model-Free Runtime Measurement of Task-Relevant Information
summary: This research proposes a model-free method for runtime measurement of task-relevant information in autonomous systems. It addresses how autonomous systems gather and interpret observations.

title: LEASH: Stay Safe in Agentic Robotics
summary: LEASH focuses on ensuring safety in agentic robotics that use foundation models like GPT and Claude. It explores challenges associated with controlling robots via these advanced models.

title: Koopman Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
summary: This paper introduces Koopman Model-Based Reinforcement Learning (K-MBRL), an algorithm for controlling nonlinear robotic systems with unknown dynamics. K-MBRL learns control policies by minimizing a combined cost objective.

title: Elastic-WAM: Adaptive Spatiotemporal Imagination for Efficient Robot Control
summary: Elastic-WAM is a World-Action Model that uses adaptive spatiotemporal imagination for efficient robot control. It aims to reduce the inference overhead of predicting future visual dynamics.

title: From Prediction to Action: Learning Physical Context for Deformable Linear Object Manipulation
summary: This research investigates learning physical context for manipulating deformable linear objects (DLOs). It distinguishes between predictive utility and decision utility for choosing manipulation actions.

title: ForeseeDrive: Future-Token Conditioning for Anticipatory Generative Driving
summary: ForeseeDrive is a system that uses future-token conditioning for anticipatory generative driving. It enables shaping candidate generation for diverse ego futures in generative driving planners.

title: Gaussian Process-Augmented Model Predictive Contouring Control for 6-DoF Trajectory Tracking with a Holonomic AUV
summary: This paper proposes Gaussian Process-Augmented Model Predictive Contouring Control (MPCC) for 6-DoF trajectory tracking with holonomic Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs). It addresses accurate position and attitude tracking under state and input constraints.

title: SIGMO: Sigmoid Gated Interaction-Aware Motion Planning
summary: SIGMO introduces Sigmoid Gated Interaction-Aware Motion Planning for autonomous vehicle technologies. It aims to improve reliable navigation in cluttered environments requiring interaction-aware strategies.

title: One Policy for 100 Household Tasks: Our Solution for the 2026 BEHAVIOR Challenge
summary: This article describes a solution for the 2026 BEHAVIOR Challenge, using a single vision-language-action (VLA) model for 100 long-horizon household tasks in a simulator. The solution achieved a top-10 ranking.

title: Is Your Robot's Memory Just a Clock? Temporal Shortcuts in Memory-Augmented VLA Policies
summary: This research questions the effectiveness of memory-augmented VLA policies in robots, specifically if their memory is merely a clock-based sampling of frames. It examines temporal shortcuts in how robots store and recall information.

title: MouldIt: Data Efficiency of Multi-Task Temporal Representation Learning in Injection Moulding
summary: MouldIt examines the data efficiency of multi-task temporal representation learning for industrial injection moulding processes. It aims to develop smart industrial solutions that understand underlying processes.
